description: This file contains utility functions and templates for reduction operations (sum, mean, min, max, product) optimized for CPU vectorization, including initialization, update, and reduction logic, used within the ATen library for tensor computations.

methods.name: AT_DISPATCH_REDUCTION_TYPES
methods.description: Macro to dispatch code based on reduction type (SUM, MEAN, MIN, MAX, PROD).

methods.name: init_value
methods.description: Template function to initialize reduction accumulator based on reduction type.

methods.name: init_value (overload)
methods.description: Template function to initialize reduction accumulator with an optional initial value.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Template function to initialize output array with a scalar value.

methods.name: init (overload)
methods.description: Template function to initialize output array with an optional initial value.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Template function to initialize buffer or self pointer for reduction.

methods.name: _max
methods.description: Template function to compute maximum, handling NaN for scalar types.

methods.name: _min
methods.description: Template function to compute minimum, handling NaN for scalar types.

methods.name: map_acc
methods.description: Template function to apply a binary operation over vectors with floating point reduction.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Template function to update reduction result with new data, based on reduction type.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Function to finalize reduction, e.g., compute mean by dividing by count.
